verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own keyboard-driven Omarchy Menu has an Install section. Through it you can install curated editors (VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, Helix), alternative terminals, development environments and a Windows VM. One hands-on user also says installing software is easy and lightning-fast. However, this is a curated menu of mostly developer tools, not a documented app store with a broad catalog of popular desktop apps and one-click GUI installs. missing for 10: a documented built-in app store or GUI catalog, coverage of mainstream consumer desktop apps, explicit one-click install flow, and independent corroboration of the install experience for switchers.
